messages:
anya: Quick support follow-up: a customer reported the quickstart CLI printed 'OK' but produced no text. They pasted the stdout and the raw response we returned. This one feels different: the response had HTTP 200 but a tiny JSON with 'preview_experiment' and an odd header X-Experiment: true.

 tom: can you paste the exact stdout + response body? we need to know if SDK swallowed an error.

 anya: stdout:
```
$ redwood-hello --api-key sk-zzzz
Starting generation for model=open-7b
OK
Done
```
raw body (redacted):
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
X-Experiment: preview-rollout

{"id":"p_202","status":"preview","detail":"preview_experiment","message":"Preview-only access: accept billing to generate full output","streaming":false}

The user saw a token footprint in their dashboard then no output in the CLI. SDK used: rust-sdk v0.2.0 (the quickstart uses the rust sample).

infra: ah yes, we rolled a small experiment that returns 200 + header for a subset of trial orgs. The intent was to show a preview banner in UI without breaking clients, but obviously breaks streaming clients that expect chunked event streams.

 tom: rust-sdk v0.2.0 probably treats any 200 as success and only parses event streams when content-type=application/x-ndjson or transfer-encoding: chunked. Single JSON then close becomes zero-event stream. We should make SDKs detect preview sentinel body.

 anya: user is anxious about being billed. billing-bot, can you confirm whether this shows up as chargeable?

 billing-bot: Preview attempts are logged as 'preview_trace' and are not billed. However, some dashboard views conflate preview_trace with normal usage counts. We'll add filtering and a tooltip. For this workspace the attempt is not charged.

 tom: immediate action items: (1) infra: stop using 200-with-preview-body for gateways; prefer 402 or add X-Redwood-Gate header so clients can detect gating reliably (ticket INF-4899). (2) SDK: rust-sdk patch to detect bodies where streaming=false and detail in ["preview_experiment","billing_preview_only","billing_ack_required","service_account_blocked"] and raise a BillingPreviewError instead of returning success. (3) CLI sample: change message from 'OK' to 'Received response' and inspect the body for error sentinel; print human-friendly guidance.

 anya: can we provide an immediate workaround for the customer?

 billing-bot: recommend the workspace admin accept billing invite. If they cannot, create a temporary billing-enabled org or use an org-internal test token which bypasses the preview experiment. Also reassure them preview attempts are not billed.

 infra: will add a short-term flag to the experiment to set X-Experiment: preview-rollout only for UI flows, and will change server to emit 402 for blocked generation within 48 hours. INF-4899 created.

 tom: I'll prepare rust-sdk@0.2.1 patch that checks response bodies for sentinel fields when streaming is false and returns a proper error. Also will change retry middleware to not retry on 4xx or preview sentinel bodies. Add a unit test that mocks a 200-with-preview-body and asserts error is returned.

 anya: sent the workaround to the customer and they accepted billing contact; retry produced streaming text. They were relieved.

 devex-bot: release note: rust-sdk@0.2.1 published - surfaces billing preview errors for single-json responses; CLI quickstart updated to surface guidance.

 tom: follow-ups: docs FAQ blurb for onboarding "Why did my quickstart say OK but show no text?" + CS canned response and a dashboard tooltip update. Closing after INF-4899 and SDK PR merged.

 anya: thanks all, closing the loop. :sparkles:
